title: M3 deterministic reference fixture manifest / M3 确定性参考 fixture 清单
description: Manifest contract for byte-hashed synthetic/reference fixtures used to verify corrected filtering, IMU gravity separation, peak detection and PRV behavior. Fixtures prove implementation behavior but do not establish clinical performance. / 用于验证校正滤波、IMU 重力分离、峰检测与 PRV 行为的逐字节哈希合成/参考 fixture 清单合同。Fixture 可证明实现行为，但不能证明临床性能。

schema_version.description: Optional explicit schema version for newly regenerated manifests; the existing v1 byte-hashed snapshot predates this field. / 新重生成清单可显式记录的 Schema 版本；现有 v1 逐字节快照早于该字段。

fixture_manifest_id.description: Frozen fixture-set identity. / 冻结 fixture 集标识。

status.description: Fixture materialization state. / fixture 实体化状态。

generator.description: Path relative to the M3 package; absolute paths are forbidden. / 相对 M3 包的路径；禁止绝对路径。

seed.description: Deterministic generator seed. / 确定性生成器种子。

sampling_rate_hz.description: Nominal fixture sampling rate. / fixture 标称采样率。

files.description: Unique fixture entries; file-name uniqueness and on-disk hashes are validator-enforced. / 唯一 fixture 条目；文件名唯一性与磁盘哈希由 validator 强制。

limitations.description: Scientific and operational limits of the fixture set. / fixture 集的科学与运行限制。

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 digest over exact file bytes. / 精确文件字节的小写 SHA-256 摘要。

file.description: File name within reference_fixtures; no traversal or absolute path. / reference_fixtures 内文件名；禁止路径穿越或绝对路径。

bytes.description: Optional exact byte length for additional integrity checking. / 用于附加完整性检查的可选精确字节数。

dtype.description: Stored NumPy/serialized data type. / 存储的 NumPy/序列化数据类型。

shape.description: Exact stored array shape. / 精确存储数组形状。

columns.description: Ordered columns for multichannel fixtures. / 多通道 fixture 的有序列名。

semantics.description: Bilingual or otherwise explicit scientific meaning of the fixture payload. / fixture 载荷的双语或其他明确科学含义。
